# nanopb

Runtime from https://github.com/nanopb/nanopb, tag 0.4.9.1,
commit `cad3c18ef15a663e30e3e43e3a752b66378adec1`.
License preserved in LICENSE.txt. No runtime modifications.

Only the portable C runtime is vendored. The SolarOS Meshtastic companion client
uses a bounded, project-owned protocol subset under `src/services/mesh/`.
